title: Ali Is Sick
text:
Ali has a headache today. He has a fever too. He stays in bed and drinks water.

His mother calls the doctor. The doctor says Ali needs rest. He must take medicine two times a day. In three days, Ali feels better.

questions.text: Why does Ali stay in bed?
options: He is sick and needs rest
He is waiting for a friend

questions.text: What can we say about Ali's health at the end of the story?
options: He needs to go to hospital

vocabulary.definition: a body temperature that is higher than normal when you are ill
a substance you take to make you better when you are ill
time when you relax and do not work or move much

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin bugün baş ağrısı var. Ateşi de var. Yatakta kalır ve su içer.
Annesi doktoru arar. Doktor, Ali'nin dinlenmeye ihtiyacı olduğunu söyler. Günde iki kez ilaç almalı. Üç gün sonra Ali kendini daha iyi hisseder.
